## v3.0.0 — 2026-05-04

This is a landmark v3.0.0 release, signifying a major transition to an open-core model. The project has undergone significant architectural and business model changes, including relicensing, a repository split, and the complete removal of legacy tiers. Additionally, new community engagement features have been introduced to support the open-source initiative.

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- The project's licensing model has transitioned to open-core, with the engine, CLI, and pro components now under the MIT license, and the hosted platform components remaining source-available.
- The codebase has been split into a dedicated `cullit-oss` repository for open-source components, while the original repository now exclusively hosts the private, platform-only codebase.
- All legacy tiers and associated billing infrastructure have been removed, completing the full conversion to an open-source product offering.

### ✨ Features

- New calls-to-action (CTAs) for sponsoring and starring the project are now surfaced across the README, landing page, dashboard, and CLI, supported by a new GitHub Sponsors funding configuration.

### 🧹 Chores

- Internal CI/CD workflows have been enhanced with guards to prevent accidental open-source publishing from the private repository and to mirror licensed tests.
